cases.name: Brianne Nicole Otley
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Brianne was a 2009 graduate of Northmont High School. She worked for various places around the area in customer service. Brianne was a single mom, who loved and adored her kids. She enjoyed shopping and had a deep appreciation for tattoos and piercings. Recently, Brianne had returned to church and was attending the Greenville Baptist Church."
